limits: Draws the tree given; it estimates nothing.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Lays out a tree someone else inferred, with the same layout the panel uses.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this tree look like as a figure?

description: Draw a tree as an SVG figure — rectangular, slanted, circular or unrooted, as a phylogram or a cladogram, with tip names, branch support and a scale bar. The same layout the phylogeny panel draws with, so the figure and the panel place every node identically. Wire `newick` from build_tree or edit_tree.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

branch_lengths.description: phylogram: horizontal distance IS evolutionary distance. Off draws a cladogram, which shows the topology alone — and then no scale bar is drawn, because the drawing is not to scale.

layout.description: drawing style; `unrooted` is the only honest one for a tree whose method inferred no root, because a rectangular drawing of it implies a root that was never inferred. Values: rectangular (Rectangular), slanted (Slanted), circular (Circular), unrooted (Unrooted).

length_unit.description: what the branch lengths MEAN, for the scale bar's caption. A tree read from a file carries no unit, so say what it is rather than letting the bar claim substitutions/site. Advanced.

min_support.description: below this, a support value is not printed. Only applies when support is true. Advanced.

newick.description: the tree to draw — wire `newick` from build_tree, or paste one.

support.description: print each internal branch's support value where it carries one.

tip_labels.description: print each tip's name, reserving the gutter they need.

unrooted_method.description: which unrooted algorithm places the nodes; equal daylight only rotates subtrees about their nodes, so it preserves every branch length. Only applies when layout is unrooted. Advanced.

name: draw_tree

pixelsPerUnit.description: px per unit of branch length in THIS drawing, or 0 when the drawing is not to scale and no bar was drawn

svg.description: the figure as an SVG string
